opc-triz-innovation 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the opc-triz-innovation skill, providing a comprehensive TRIZ-based innovation methodology for OPC entrepreneurs and manufacturing professionals.
- Includes core tools: 40 invention principles, 39×39 contradiction matrix, substance-field (Su-Field) analysis, and technical/physical contradiction solving.
- Integrates product innovation methods (36 Stratagems) and the DIKWP-TRIZ hybrid framework for value-driven innovation.
- Offers detailed mappings and step-by-step workflows for systematic problem analysis and solution generation.
- Compatible with Coze, with aliases and directory metadata for OPC mentor guidance.
